summary: Draganfly Inc. filed a Form 6-K with a press release announcing selection as a Qualified Supplier under Canada's Defence Drone Initiative (DDI) Marketplace, effective August 28, 2026, across all five capability streams. The DDI, launched in July 2026, relates to government plans for approximately $180 billion in defence procurement over a decade. This is an operational business development announcement, not a special situation. No financial terms, transactions, or structural changes were disclosed. The filing is routine; no deal terms, advisors, or risk-arbitrage angles apply. Watch for future contract awards under the DDI Marketplace.
